title: Ropedia Xperience-10M Raw Public Sample Files

dataset.hosting_policy: Raw files are streamed or downloaded from the official public sample dataset. This task-suite repo mirrors derived artifacts and metadata only.

browser_preview_policy: The website includes compact 12 second H.264/AAC fast-start preview clips derived from the official public MP4 files so video and audio can play immediately in browsers. The complete raw MP4, HDF5, and RRD source links remain the authoritative files.

windowization.note: The public task suite converts the raw episode into overlapping 20-frame windows with a 5-frame stride.

files.name: annotation.hdf5
files.role: Primary synchronized annotation and sensor container.
contains: camera pose and SLAM point cloud
files.task_suite_use: Loaded by HOMIE and task-suite scripts to build aligned labels, sensor features, windows, object labels, and diagnostics.

reader_sections.title: Inside
reader_sections.text: Caption JSON, object and interaction labels, depth/confidence arrays, camera pose and SLAM values, full-body and hand mocap, IMU, calibration, timestamps, and source metadata.

reader_sections.title: How it relates
reader_sections.text: The six MP4 streams provide synchronized video/audio. annotation.hdf5 supplies the aligned labels and non-RGB sensor timelines used to build 20-frame windows, task targets, and derived public-safe features.

reader_sections.title: Open with
reader_sections.text: Use h5py, HDFView, or HOMIE Toolkit readers. Inspect groups/datasets selectively instead of loading the whole 1.93 GB file into memory.

files.name: fisheye_cam0.mp4
files.role: Fisheye camera 0 stream and the public sample audio source.
files.task_suite_use: Video features feed visual tasks; the embedded audio stream feeds audio ablation and acoustic feature blocks.

files.task_suite_use: Used as one of the synchronized visual feature streams.

files.task_suite_use: Used as one of the synchronized visual feature streams.

files.name: stereo_left.mp4
files.task_suite_use: Used for visual features and multi-view consistency retrieval targets.

files.name: stereo_right.mp4

files.name: visualization.rrd
files.role: Optional Rerun visualization bundle for the sample episode.
files.task_suite_use: Not used for training or metrics; useful for external visual inspection with Rerun 0.29.0.

reader_sections.title: Inside
reader_sections.text: A prebuilt Rerun recording of the sample episode for visual inspection of the episode timeline and viewer state.

reader_sections.title: How it relates
reader_sections.text: It is a convenience viewer artifact beside the raw MP4 and annotation files. It helps inspect alignment, but it is not an input to the published task scores.

reader_sections.title: Open with
reader_sections.text: Download the .rrd file and open it in Rerun 0.29.0. The browser links the official source instead of embedding the 2.70 GB binary.

hdf5_organization.description: Camera intrinsics/extrinsics and static calibration values used to align sensor streams.
JSON text with task config, action segments, object mentions, interaction descriptions, and global summary.
Depth maps and confidence channels aligned to the episode timeline.
Full-body joint and contact signals for human motion modeling.
Left and right hand joint trajectories used by hand-motion and forecast tasks.
Accelerometer and gyroscope streams sampled at higher frequency than the video frames.
Episode metadata, frame indexing, and source bookkeeping.
Camera trajectory, pose, and sparse SLAM point-cloud information.
Video stream metadata and per-frame alignment information.
